mapper.select: SELECT id, exam_id, student_id, subject_id, class_id, school_id, score, is_absent, rank_in_class, rank_in_grade, rank_in_school, recorder_id, status, recorded_at, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM score WHERE deleted = 0 AND exam_id = #{examId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT es.id AS id, e.id AS examId, e.exam_name AS examName, sc.id AS classId, sc.class_name AS className, sub.id AS subjectId, sub.subject_name AS subjectName, sub.full_score AS fullScore, MIN(s.status) AS status, COUNT(s.id) AS enteredCount FROM exam_subject es JOIN exam e ON e.id = es.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 JOIN subject sub ON sub.id = es.subject_id AND sub.deleted = 0 JOIN score s ON s.exam_id = e.id AND s.subject_id = sub.id AND s.deleted = 0 JOIN class sc ON sc.id = s.class_id AND sc.deleted = 0 WHERE es.deleted = 0 AND e.id = #{examId} AND sc.id = #{classId} AND sub.id = #{subjectId} AND e.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY es.id, e.id, e.exam_name, sc.id, sc.class_name, sub.id, sub.subject_name, sub.full_score ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, sc.class_name, sub.subject_name

SELECT g.id AS gradeId, g.grade_name AS gradeName, c.id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, sub.id AS subjectId, sub.subject_name AS subjectName, COUNT(cs.student_id) AS totalCount, COUNT(s.id) AS enteredCount FROM class c JOIN grade g ON g.id = c.grade_id AND g.deleted = 0 JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id = c.id JOIN exam_subject es ON es.exam_id = #{examId} AND es.deleted = 0 JOIN subject sub ON sub.id = es.subject_id AND sub.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN score s ON s.exam_id = #{examId} AND s.class_id = c.id AND s.subject_id = sub.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam e WHERE e.id = #{examId} AND (FIND_IN_SET(CAST(c.grade_id AS CHAR), e.grade_ids) > 0 OR e.grade_ids IS NULL) AND e.school_id = c.school_id ) GROUP BY g.id, g.grade_name, c.id, c.class_name, sub.id, sub.subject_name ORDER BY g.grade_code, c.class_code, sub.subject_name
